annotations.title: Send the store details to both stores

description: Checks every answer against both stores' rules and, when nothing would be refused, sends every draft to App Store Connect and Google Play in one go, saying per part what each took. When something would be refused, nothing is sent and the problems come back with the step to fix each in. Apple keeps what's for a version with App Review (Ploa sends it once Apple decides); an agent's price change becomes an approval. Needs a token allowed to submit; otherwise tell the person to press Send on the Store details page.

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.
